cjc-1295-no-dac.warning: NOT VERIFIED. The bulk lookup fell back to sermorelin (GRF 1-29, C149H246N44O42S, MW 3357.9, CAS 86168-78-7). CJC-1295 without DAC is modified GRF (1-29), which carries amino-acid substitutions sermorelin does not have - they are NOT the same molecule. PubChem returns no record for "CJC-1295 without DAC" or "modified GRF (1-29)" (verified 2026-11-09). Do not publish sermorelin identifiers on this page.

h-frag.correction: Bulk lookup fell back to AOD9604 (C78H123N23O23S2, MW 1815.1). These are DIFFERENT molecules: AOD9604 is a modified fragment carrying an additional N-terminal tyrosine. Do not conflate them on either product page.

hcg.note: GLYCOPROTEIN HORMONE - no valid small-molecule record. Bulk lookup under "chorionic gonadotropin" returned CID 1108 (C17H28, MW 232.4), which is a name collision and certainly not hCG. REJECTED. hCG is a heterodimeric glycoprotein of roughly 36-38 kDa; a molecular formula must NOT be stated for it. Describe by subunit composition and approximate mass only.

igf-1-lr3.note: NO PUBCHEM RECORD. IGF-1 LR3 is an 83-residue recombinant analogue of IGF-1 (Arg3 substitution plus a 13-residue N-terminal extension), approx 9.1 kDa. State by description and approximate mass; do not assert a molecular formula.

kpv.correction: Bulk lookup under the name "KPV" returned CID 13294447 (C11H12O3, MW 192.21) - a name collision, NOT a tripeptide. Rejected. Verified instead via the explicit sequence name Lys-Pro-Val.

tb-500.warning: AMBIGUITY - MUST BE DISCLOSED ON THE PAGE. The bulk lookup resolved "TB-500" to full-length thymosin beta-4 (43 residues, ~4963 Da). Material sold as "TB-500" is very often the short active fragment Ac-LKKTETQ (thymosin beta-4 17-23, ~889 Da), not the full protein. PubChem has no record under "TB-500", "Ac-LKKTETQ" or "thymosin beta 4 (17-23)" (verified 2026-11-09). Which of the two is supplied is NOT VERIFIED for this product. State both possibilities and the ~5.6x mass difference; do not assert either.
